paragraphs.text: Kangaroo is a creature type for cards which depict a species of marsupial noted for hopping and bouncing on their hind legs.

Kangaroo only appears on 2 cards: the acorn Mother Kangaroo and the eternal legal Rabaroo Troop , which are mono- green and mono- white , respectively. Consequently, they don't have a standard color in which they appear, though this may change in the future.

Kangaroo debuted as a creature type in Unstable on a host creature. Its first eternal appearance was with Rabaroo Troop which is a rabbit kangaroo hybrid from Universes Beyond 's Avatar: The Last Airbender .
A hybrid penguin kangaroo inhabited Bablovia at one time.
Rabaroos are a rare animal that inhabits the earth kingdom. They are a cross between a kangaroo and a rabbit. They look like larger rabbits with pouches.
